title: Vault 112 Causal-Coherence Fracture and Identity-State Leak Forensics

user_clarification.intended_meaning: Data from the simulation escaped the Vault 112 system boundary on a physical memory chip.
user_clarification.not_intended: The user did not mean that the Tranquility Lane program globally crashed for all participants.

scope: Model the system-level effect of T. Dithers' anomaly and, separately, the confirmed physical egress of simulation-related memory state from Vault 112 through Pinkerton's stolen memory chip. Do not conflate data egress with a global simulation crash and do not bind the stolen chip to Dithers without asset-level evidence.

terminology.simulation_data_egress: Simulation-related memory/state data physically leaves the Vault 112 authority boundary on a memory chip.
terminology.memory_state_exfiltration: An opaque memory artifact is removed from the original system without an established subject-controlled provenance or consent channel.
terminology.identity_state_leak: Memory/identity state leaves the original authority boundary and becomes causally effective in another entity or system.
terminology.causal_exfiltration: A state artifact removed from one closed system produces downstream consequences outside that system.
terminology.causal_coherence_fracture: A local failure of narrative/state consistency in which assigned memories, identity, social role and perceived environment no longer form one self-consistent history for a subject.
terminology.warning: These are analytical system-design terms, not terminology used by Bethesda in shipped Fallout 3.

dithers_local_fault.subject: T. Dithers / Old Lady Dithers
confirmed_observations: Dithers states that Tranquility Lane is not real and that the residents are sleeping/dreaming.
Dithers identifies Betty as Braun behind another face.
Dithers knows that Timmy is not really a boy.
Dithers knows of the hidden failsafe and directs the Lone Wanderer toward it.
Dithers reports that she cannot sleep normally, hears voices and feels that her own skin is wrong.
Her physical Vault 112 lounger reports inconsistent readings, pod-connection warning, blood-pressure error, impossible temperature readout, extreme stress and an anomaly warning.

simulation_data_egress.meaning: Data/state generated, stored or used by the Vault 112 simulation-memory system physically leaves the closed experiment and becomes available to an external operator.

stolen_chip_causal_propagation.confirmed_source_statement: Pinkerton states that he stole a mem chip from Braun while Braun was absorbed in the simulation and that he would not know whose memories were on it until integration into a new host.
downstream_chain: -> INTEGRATION INTO A3-21 VIA CIRCUIT NEURALIZER / MEMORY PROCEDURE
-> HARKNESS BECOMES SECURITY CHIEF / COUNCIL FIGURE
-> THE REPLICATED MAN QUEST CAN RESTORE THE HIDDEN A3-21 IDENTITY
stolen_chip_causal_propagation.system_level_result: The important 'escape' is the escape of simulation/memory data across the Vault 112 boundary. Once outside, that state becomes causally active in another entity and alters real external social history.

causal_chain_analysis.inside_vault112: Dithers provides a separate local coherence anomaly whose mechanism remains unresolved.
causal_chain_analysis.across_vault112_boundary: Pinkerton's theft is a confirmed physical data-egress event: memory/simulation state exits the experiment boundary.
causal_chain_analysis.outside_vault112: The exfiltrated state is reused in A3-21 and becomes part of the causal history of Harkness and Rivet City.
causal_chain_analysis.key_distinction: DATA ESCAPES THE SIMULATION SYSTEM; THE SIMULATION ITSELF DOES NOT NEED TO CRASH.

pinkerton_dithers_hypothesis.hypothesis: Pinkerton stole Dithers' specific memory chip and that removal contributed to her abnormal awareness.
supporting_circumstances: Dithers is the unique awareness witness among the original residents.
Pinkerton physically exfiltrated a Vault 112 mem chip.
Vault 112 memory technology is demonstrably capable of rewriting perceived identity.
blocking_evidence_gap: Pinkerton explicitly states that he does not know whose memories are on the chip before integration.
No shipped Form ID, terminal entry, dialogue or script binding currently identifies the stolen chip as Dithers' chip.
No shipped line states that removal of the chip caused Dithers' awareness.
pinkerton_dithers_hypothesis.promotion_rule: Do not promote to confirmed unless a shipped asset or developer source binds the stolen chip to Dithers or directly links the theft to her anomaly.

janus_genesis_comparison.engineering_lesson: A simulation may remain operational while sensitive identity-state data escapes its authority boundary. Causal auditability therefore requires provenance and admission checks at export/import boundaries, not merely runtime stability.

hardening_candidate.name: CAUSAL_LINEAGE_AND_IMPORTED_MEMORY_ADMISSION_GATE
requirements: every exported/imported resident-memory fragment declares source artifact/state ID
source and destination identity bindings are explicit
current consent/reuse policy is recorded where required
export does not silently detach provenance from memory state
import cannot retroactively rewrite signed/authoritative Chronicle history
conflicts create a visible branch or unresolved state instead of silent overwrite
external AI-proposed memory remains non-authoritative until runtime admission
hardening_candidate.goal: Prevent a Genesis analogue of a stolen Vault 112 memory chip from escaping one state boundary and silently becoming authoritative identity truth in another.

ru: Под 'вылетом симуляции' здесь понимается не падение Tranquility Lane, а выход данных симуляции за границу Vault 112 на физическом memory chip.
Симуляция может продолжать работать, даже если её memory/identity state уже физически эксфильтрован наружу.
Кража чипа делает Vault 112 информационно и причинно незамкнутым: внутреннее состояние системы становится причиной внешней личности Harkness.
Аномалия Dithers рассматривается отдельно; связь украденного чипа именно с ней остаётся нерешённой.
Для Janus Genesis урок состоит в защите не только runtime, но и границы экспорта/импорта состояния: provenance должен путешествовать вместе с памятью.
en: Here, 'simulation escape' means data egress from the Tranquility Lane/Vault 112 system on a physical memory chip, not a global program crash.
A simulation can remain operational even after memory/identity state has been physically exfiltrated beyond its authority boundary.
The stolen chip makes Vault 112 informationally and causally non-closed: internal system state becomes a cause of the external Harkness identity.
The Dithers anomaly is analyzed separately; no shipped evidence currently binds the stolen chip specifically to her.
For Janus Genesis, the lesson is to secure state export/import boundaries as well as runtime: provenance must travel with memory.
